2) Patch workspace files as needed.

Do not run the full remaining 19-iteration campaign yourself; only patch and bounded-validate. Use the shared workspace.

`digital_osl_stage1b/campaign.py` treated `client.get_diagnostics(...)` as mandatory and uncaught.
